source.procedure: Run node assets/ecosystem/galapagos-land-iguana/source/generate-land-iguana.mjs. Topology-stable morphs are required for InstancedMesh trait expression; Foxel remeshing cannot prove that contract. Sprawl, tail length, and spine spacing follow the MarineIguana blockout proportions (not its GLB, marine charcoal, or flattened swim tail).

acceptance.verdict: Accepted by the owner on 2026-08-18 as the Galápagos land-iguana founder family for the proof. Owner: "the iguana model passes for now." Crest—not mammal horns—carries hornLength. Scope is the founder look at gameplay distance; not proof placement, descendant split, or motion.
